summaryDeep: Your minds move well together. Conversation flows and ideas build. Use the easy talk to sort things out early.
tension: The challenge with easy communication is assuming it will take care of itself. It is tempting to rely on the fact that you usually understand each other. But relationships change. People change.
advice: Keep staying curious. Let the conversation keep evolving as the relationship evolves. The real gift is not the ease itself. It is having enough trust in the connection to tell the truth more deeply as time goes on.
